newsitem.title: USA: Petsmart shares dive after analyst cuts rating.
newsitem.headline: Petsmart shares dive after analyst cuts rating.

text.p: Petsmart Inc. stock plummeted in heavy trading Friday, losing nearly a fourth of its value, after a Wall Street firm cut its rating for the nation's largest pet superstore chain.
The stock dropped $3.8125 to $12.125 at midday on Nasdaq, where it was the biggest percentage loser and the second most active share on volume of more than 11 million shares.
Earlier, Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette downgraded its rating on the stock to buy from recommended. Additional details were not immediately available.

In February, the Phoenix-based company reported a fiscal fourth-quarter profit of $7.59 million, or 6 cents a share, down 47 percent from $14.42 million, or 17 cents a share, in the same period a year ago.
